blurb: Play the whole game from one Disc 1 image on CSR. v0.2.8: fixes the D1->D2 transition hang (BLACKBGB) and LOST2 background corruption, confirmed on DuckStation emulator. Manip movies and endings are disabled pending re-validation on this new base.
hint: CSR. Fields-only core; movies/endings not yet re-enabled.
betaNote: v0.2.8: fixes two showstopper regressions, both confirmed on DuckStation emulator (not yet tested on real hardware). D1->D2 transition (BLACKBGB) no longer hangs -- spliced in a known-working manually-edited BLACKBGB.DAT in place of the auto re-encoded one. LOST2 background corruption fixed via a bit-exact Okumura LZSS port replacing the previous from-scratch LZS encoder, which benefits every recompressed field. Retains all v0.2.7 fixes. Manip movies and endings are currently disabled while this core is playtested standalone.
